To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the assessment of student learning outcomes in general education is a complex and challenging endeavor.

(a) faculty members in general education programs are not satisfied with their assessment practices; (b) faculty members' assessment practices are not aligned with the goals of their programs; (c) students' perceptions of their own learning in general education programs do not align with the perceptions of faculty members; and (d) students' perceptions do not align with faculty members' perceptions of students' learning in general education.

the general education assessment practices of faculty and institutions are changing in ways that reflect changing faculty roles, students' changing expectations for higher education and the increased demand for accountability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) What is the role of the assessment of learning outcomes in general education?
the following questions: (1) What are the characteristics of effective general education assessment practices?
the assessment of student learning in general education programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need for more research and more information about how to conduct assessment in a way that is both effective and efficient.
there is a lack of conclusive statements about general education assessment.
the future of general education is in flux, and the assessment of general education student learning will be an integral part of that process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the general education assessment community is in a state of flux and that the assessment of general education student learning will be an ongoing challenge.
general education assessment is a dynamic, ever-changing process that requires a flexible approach to evaluation.
general education assessment is a dynamic and complex process, and that the process is likely to become more dynamic and complex in the near future.
The main takeaway from our work is that
general education assessment is a dynamic process.
assessment is a process that can be used to improve student learning and to provide evidence that students are achieving learning outcomes.

general education assessment is not just a matter of developing new instruments and implementing them, but of understanding how general education is defined and taught and how students' learning is measured.
